name: National Solar Solutions
old_description: At National Solar Solutions, we specialize in the detachment and resetting of solar panels for residential homes nationwide. Our expert team ensures that your solar panels are carefully removed and reinstalled, whether it’s for roof repairs, home renovations, or other maintenance needs. With a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we help homeowners maintain the efficiency and longevity of their solar energy systems. Trust National Solar Solutions for all your solar panel needs and experience seamless, professional service tailored to your specific requirements.
about:
National Solar Solutions is a solar energy service company headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The firm operates nationally, providing specialized solar panel detachment and reset services alongside new system installations and battery storage solutions.

The company’s core offerings center on three service lines: detach and reset of existing solar arrays for roof repairs or renovations, turnkey installation of new photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, and integration of battery storage to enhance energy independence. Services are delivered through a network of strategically located offices across the United States, though specific facility sizes and staffing levels are not disclosed.

National Solar Solutions serves residential homeowners and commercial property owners seeking to maintain, upgrade, or install solar energy systems. Its detach-and-reset service addresses a niche need when roofing work requires temporary panel removal, while its installation and storage services cater to customers adopting solar for the first time or expanding existing arrays.

The company emphasizes a streamlined, customer-focused approach, promoting a “full-service” model that handles permitting, installation, and ongoing support. It differentiates itself through nationwide coverage and a free online quote system designed to simplify the procurement process for solar services.

name: National Textile & Apparel Inc
old_description: Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Hazlehurst, Mississippi, National Textile is North America's largest manufacturer of protective clothing for Nuclear power, weapons, environment restoration and industrial applications.
about:
National Textile & Apparel Inc was founded in 1994 in Hazlehurst, Mississippi, where it remains headquartered The company began as a manufacturer of protective clothing for nuclear power, weapons programs, environmental restoration, and industrial applications.

The company produces a broad range of sewn products including work and safety coveralls, insulated hunting coveralls, jackets, bibs, parkas, inmate apparel, underwear, laundry bags, shoe covers, hoods, medical scrubs, chef pants and coats, orange jumpsuits, and digital camouflage coveralls. It operates as a custom manufacturer with capabilities in textile and apparel fabrication, gas transfer printing, and sublimation transfer printing. Finished goods are shipped domestically and internationally to destinations such as New Zealand, Australia, and Canada.

National Textile serves the nuclear energy, environmental remediation, industrial safety, food service, healthcare, corrections, military, and cleanroom sectors. Customers include a West Coast cafe that ordered custom-printed chef coats and a Canadian client that added logos to breast pockets. The company also supplies protective clothing to energy department and cleanroom facilities.

Its quality policy commits the organization to the highest level of quality to conform to customer requirements, and its vision targets defect-free protective clothing that exceeds industry and government standards.

name: Natural Edge Furniture
old_description: Natural Edge Furniture crafts timeless, custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged responsibly from the Pacific Northwest. Our expert craftsmen help you with design and make recommendations on wood species to help your vision become reality. We specialize in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables and benches.
about:
Based in the Maker's District of Bend, Oregon, Natural Edge Furniture builds custom furniture from premium wood slabs salvaged from the Pacific Northwest. The company operates as Natural Edge Furniture & Supply, offering both finished pieces and a slab inventory for customer projects.

The shop specializes in large dining and conference tables, desks, occasional tables, and benches. Expert craftsmen assist with design and wood-species recommendations, milling and finishing slabs such as walnut, blue pine, African sapele, white oak, madrone, hickory, elm, and fumed white oak. The facility also maintains a stock of live-edge slabs for direct purchase.

Customers include residential buyers seeking one-of-a-kind tables and benches, as well as commercial clients needing conference tables and office furniture. Interior designers and woodworkers also source slabs from the inventory for their own projects.

Natural Edge Furniture emphasizes environmental responsibility, stating it continually reduces its carbon footprint through energy-efficient operations, waste minimization, sourcing from suppliers with green manufacturing practices, and ongoing recycling and donation programs.

name: Nebraska Prep Equipment
old_description: Nebraska Prep Equipment was founded by Cory Hart and Jamison Wallman in late 2017. While building their last catering kitchen for their then 5-year-old catering business, they were faced with the task of sourcing quality used equipment to stay within budget. Cory and Jamison found that quality used equipment was few and far between locally, so they broadened their search area and found a great amount of quality used equipment in the larger cities throughout the Midwest. Instead of keeping this treasure hidden, Jamison and Cory decided to start transporting this equipment back to Southeast Nebraska, cleaning the equipment and reselling it at a fair price to other food service companies in the area. Nebraska Prep Equipment started to gain traction and the option for new equipment was added to our inventory eventually leading to the offering of new equipment with manufacturer warranty as well as occasional new scratch and dent units at a discounted price.
about:
Nebraska Prep Equipment is based in Adams, Nebraska. The company was founded in late 2017 by Cory Hart and Jamison Wallman. While building a catering kitchen for their own catering business, the pair struggled to find quality used equipment locally. They expanded their search to larger Midwestern cities, began transporting equipment back to southeast Nebraska, cleaning it, and reselling it to other food service operators.

The business operates as a food service equipment supplier, offering both used and new equipment. Used items are sourced, cleaned, and refurbished before resale. New equipment carries manufacturer warranties, and the company also sells scratch-and-dent units at a discount. A showroom in Adams operates by appointment only.

The company serves locally owned food and hospitality businesses, including restaurants, caterers, and other food service operators in the region.

Hart and Wallman started the venture because quality used equipment was scarce in their area. They emphasize competitive pricing on quality brands and highlight their customer service throughout the buying experience as a key differentiator.

name: Nelnet Renewable Energy
old_description: Nelnet Renewable Energy has been acquired by MARS Energy Group, a national leader in commercial and utility-scale solar solutions, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, and long-term energy infrastructure.
about:
Nelnet Renewable Energy is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company was acquired by MARS Energy Group, a national leader in commercial and utility-scale solar solutions, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, and long-term energy infrastructure. Its founding year and ownership details have not been publicly disclosed.

The firm provides EPC services for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale solar projects and manages a tax equity financing platform with over $313 million under management alongside co-investment partners. It also operates a venture capital investment team focused on CleanTech and ClimateTech innovation. While many commercial solar services are now delivered through MARS Energy Group, Nelnet continues to support a set of legacy offerings for existing customers.

Its customer base includes commercial and industrial solar developers, residential solar owners in Illinois, Missouri, and Wisconsin, and tax equity investors seeking renewable energy assets. Workmanship warranty support for projects in Colorado, Indiana, Iowa, and Nebraska has been transitioned to local partners such as Photon Brothers, Jefferson Electric, SolQ, and Nebraska Solar Providers.

Nelnet emphasizes that the acquisition brings nationwide reach, proven EPC expertise, advanced technical and financial capabilities, and a commitment to reliability and transparency, positioning the combined entity for long-term performance in the solar infrastructure market.

name: Ness Electronics, Inc.
old_description: The ALL NEW Televes Multi-Market 8 Bay is here. It's a great antenna if you need a Bi-directional antenna. We partnered with Televes to design this antenna and it is exclusively available at Ness Electronics.
about:
Ness Electronics, Inc. is based in Burnsville, Minnesota, and operates from a facility in Mendota Heights after becoming part of Industry Tech Sales. In a recent transition, the company relocated to East, Suite 200, in Mendota Heights, Minnesota, and now functions under the Industry Tech Sales umbrella.

The company operates an online store and wholesale program supplying antennas and related accessories. It carries brands such as Sky Blue Antennas, BullFrog, Winegard, and Screen Kleen, and holds an exclusive partnership with Televes for the co-designed Multi-Market 8 Bay antenna. Ness Electronics does not manufacture its own products but serves as a distributor and authorized dealer for these lines. The company’s online storefront offers direct-to-consumer sales while its wholesale division provides volume pricing to trade customers.

Its customers include professional installers, retail stores, audio/video dealers, and eye-care professionals who recommend its screen-cleaning products. The wholesale program targets installers and stores seeking volume pricing. The product lineup emphasizes long-range reception and durability, with the Sky Blue series marketed for fringe-area reception up to 65 miles.

Ness Electronics differentiates itself through exclusive product arrangements, a five-year warranty on Sky Blue antennas, and a focus on serving professional installers with dedicated wholesale pricing. The exclusive Televes partnership and the five-year warranty on Sky Blue antennas are highlighted as key differentiators in the company’s messaging.

name: Nevada Distribution & Control
old_description: After working for wholesalers for many years, I decided to open this business in 1998 to offer customers personal service and excellent products for less. My many industry contacts trust in me and know that I’ll provide top-tier products and services for their needs.
about:
Nevada Distribution & Control was founded in 1998 in Las Vegas, Nevada, by an owner who had previously worked for wholesalers. The owner opened the business to offer personal service and excellent products for less, leveraging longstanding industry contacts.

The company specializes in the sale of new, reconditioned, and obsolete circuit breakers, along with related electrical components such as bus plugs, motor controls, mounting hardware, panelboard switches, and transformers. It also purchases excess inventory from clients and provides testing and repair services performed by certified AVO® technicians. No minimum or maximum order quantities are imposed.

Nevada Distribution & Control serves industrial and commercial customers nationwide, including contractors, maintenance departments, and facilities that require replacement or obsolete circuit breakers from brands such as Eaton, Square D, Siemens, General Electric, and Westinghouse.

The business was started to provide personal service and products at lower cost than traditional wholesalers, a mission reflected in its two-year warranty on all reconditioned products and its emphasis on stress-free purchasing backed by a sales team with over 50 years of combined experience.

name: Nevada Precision Sheet Metal
old_description: This high end precision machine is capable of cutting a broad range of materials in diameters between 5/8’s and 10’’, and up to 0.4’’ thick for mild steel. Bevel cutting up to 0.4’’ thick for mild steel.
about:
Nevada Precision Sheet Metal Inc. operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The company serves the prototype and rapid-turn market, fabricating from paper prints or electronic files.

The shop runs a range of metal fabrication processes: tube laser cutting on a Trumpf TruLaser Tube 7000 (5/8" to 10" diameter, up to 0.4" thick mild steel, 45° bevels), two flat lasers, high-definition plasma cutting (3–25 mm), waterjet cutting at 7,000 psi with a 13' × 6' bed and 5-axis head, CNC punching, two 14-foot shears (accuracy ±0.005"), bending, MIG/TIG welding, sand blasting with a 40 hp compressor, and powder coating in a 7' × 21' × 7' booth. In-house drafters provide 3D design and modeling.

Customers span medical (bed frames, carts, wheelchair frames), exercise equipment, food processing, architectural and construction, off-road and ATV components, signage and display fixtures, furniture (tables, shelving, garment racking), industrial equipment (conveyor, crane, forklift), playground equipment, and automotive roll cages and side impact bars.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery of quality parts for prototype and quick-turn orders, noting it houses one of Nevada's few CNC tube lasers and accepts both paper and digital drawings.

name: New Berlin Plastics Inc
old_description: New Berlin Plastics was founded in 1975 by William Aukofer and Robert Zeman. After two company moves in 1976 and 1982, business continued to expand, allowing NBP to transition to a new 100,000 square foot facility in 1998. This facility is located in New Berlin, Wisconsin and serves as the corporate headquarters and manufacturing site. In July of 2001, Jeffery Held and Mark Siewert acquired New Berlin Plastics. They worked together to grow the organization, focusing on both the day-to-day processes and the long-term goals.
about:
New Berlin Plastics was founded in 1975 by William Aukofer and Robert Zeman in New Berlin, Wisconsin. After relocations in 1976 and 1982, the company moved into a 100,000-square-foot facility in 1998 that serves as its corporate headquarters and manufacturing site. In July 2001, Jeffery Held and Mark Siewert acquired the business and have since directed its growth.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, with a focus on scientific injection molding, medical device components, engineered plastic parts, and precision molded products for OEMs across Wisconsin and North America. Operations run from the 100,000-square-foot plant, supplemented by a recently acquired second building to meet rising demand. The firm emphasizes automation, mold flow analysis, and design-for-manufacturability support, and manages over 100 simultaneous customer projects through its proprietary LaunchLogic program.

New Berlin Plastics serves a diverse set of industries, including electrical utility, automotive and transportation, specialty hand and power tools, power sports, water treatment, building and construction, controls, healthcare and medical devices, lawn and garden, industrial, pet care, marine, and small engine. Customers are primarily OEMs that value high-quality engineered components and supply-chain reliability.

The company differentiates itself through tightly controlled scientific molding processes, a 99.8% customer acceptance rate, a 2.2% internal scrap rate, and a 98% on-time launch track record via LaunchLogic. Automation integration and comprehensive value-added services — from resin selection to tool transfer — are cited as core strengths.

name: New Hampshire WoodWorks
old_description: With our stock of locally harvested maple, oak, birch, and beech wood seasoning in the drying shed, it was time to start creating with it.
about:
New Hampshire WoodWorks operates from Northwood, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 2001 as a veteran-owned and operated woodworking shop. The business began with a stock of locally harvested hardwoods seasoning in a drying shed, providing the raw material for its first handcrafted pieces.

The company produces heirloom-quality wooden goods including beehives, custom tarot reading tables, nightstand bowls, and other turned or joined items under a custom portfolio. Work is performed in-house using traditional woodworking methods; the shop seasons its own maple, oak, birch, and beech on site before machining and finishing.

Products are sold directly to individual customers seeking gift-worthy woodenware, beekeepers needing hive components, and practitioners of tarot or similar crafts. The company does not list industrial or commercial clients in its public materials.

The founder emphasizes the veteran-owned status and the use of locally sourced, air-dried lumber as distinguishing factors, positioning the shop as a source of durable, American-made heirlooms rather than mass-produced alternatives.
